verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships a built-in AI assistant called Neo, described as provisioning, governing, and optimizing infrastructure from plain-English requests ('Tell Neo what you need in plain English. It handles dependencies, executes changes, and monitors outcomes automatically'), and docs note it works alongside external AI agents. This directly matches the story of delegating tasks to a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating Neo's real-world reliability and detail on scope/limits of autonomous execution, since all evidence is first-party marketing/docs.
